questions.q: Sarnath in Uttar Pradesh was inscribed on the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) World Heritage List in July 2026, becoming India's ___ UNESCO site.
questions.explain: Sarnath became India's 45th site on the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) list, inscribed at the committee session in Busan, South Korea.

questions.q: The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, passed by the Lok Sabha in July 2026, amends an Act of which year?
questions.explain: It amends the 2024 Act covering exams of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Railway Recruitment Boards, Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) and National Testing Agency (NTA).

questions.q: In July 2026, Parliament passed a Bill to raise the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges (excluding the Chief Justice of India) from 33 to ___
questions.explain: The Bill raised the strength from 33 to 37 judges, excluding the Chief Justice of India (CJI).

questions.q: Who resigned as the Union Education Minister on 25 July 2026?
questions.explain: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on 25 July 2026; Pralhad Joshi was appointed the new Education Minister.

questions.q: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) launched which portal in July 2026 for foreign-contribution registration and related services?
questions.explain: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) 2.0 Portal was launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) with simplified forms and online tracking.

questions.q: Which city topped the Global Liveability Index 2026?
questions.explain: Copenhagen (Denmark) ranked first in the Global Liveability Index 2026, followed by Vienna and Zurich.

questions.q: According to the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) 2023–24, India's Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in higher education (ages 18–23) stood at ___
questions.explain: The All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) 2023–24 put enrolment at 4.46 crore and the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) at 28.4%.

questions.q: From July 2026, what percentage of Constable (General Duty) vacancies in the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) was reserved for ex-Agniveers?
questions.explain: The reservation for ex-Agniveers in Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) Constable (General Duty) recruitment was raised to 50%.

questions.q: Under the 'Reform Express' initiative announced in July 2026, the 8 reforms relate to which sector?
questions.explain: 'Reform Express' is a set of 8 reforms for Indian Railways covering safety, passenger experience and staff welfare.

questions.q: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved multitracking projects in July 2026 for the Kharagpur–Tatanagar, Gamharia–Chandil and Chakradharpur–Bondamunda sections, located in which states?
questions.explain: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the multitracking of three sections in Odisha and Jharkhand to decongest the Howrah–Mumbai trunk route.

questions.q: What is the outlay approved for the second phase of the Indian Semiconductor Mission (Semicon 2.0)?
questions.explain: Semicon 2.0 has an outlay of ₹1.27 lakh crore to build a full semiconductor ecosystem in India.

questions.q: QDENGA, approved in India in July 2026, is a vaccine against which disease?
questions.explain: QDENGA is India's first approved dengue vaccine, usable from age 4 years without pre-vaccination screening.

questions.q: Awiqli, approved in India in July 2026, is the world's first ___ insulin.
questions.explain: Awiqli (insulin icodec) is the world's first once-weekly basal insulin, approved by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO).

questions.q: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully hot-tested which cryogenic engine in July 2026?
questions.explain: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) hot-tested the CE20 cryogenic engine, which powers the LVM3 launch vehicle.

questions.q: In July 2026, India and which country signed a long-term pact for the supply of submarine-launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs) worth over $3 billion?
questions.explain: India signed the pact with Russia for submarine-launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs), strengthening the naval nuclear deterrent.

questions.q: Prime Minister Narendra Modi received the 'Guardian of the Blue Horizon' honour in July 2026 from which country?
questions.explain: Seychelles conferred the 'Guardian of the Blue Horizon' honour on Prime Minister (PM) Modi during his visit.

questions.q: 'Operation Amistad', launched by India in July 2026, was a humanitarian relief mission to which earthquake-hit country?
questions.explain: Operation Amistad delivered about 20 tonnes of relief material to Venezuela after an earthquake.

questions.q: Who won the International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) World Cup 2026?
questions.explain: Spain beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time in the final at MetLife Stadium, winning their second International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) World Cup title.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot award at the FIFA World Cup 2026?
questions.explain: Kylian Mbappé of France won the Golden Boot with 10 goals at the International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) World Cup 2026.

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at Wimbledon 2026?
questions.explain: Jannik Sinner defeated Alexander Zverev to win his second consecutive Wimbledon men's singles title.

questions.q: Who won India's first gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow?
questions.explain: Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu won India's first gold of the Commonwealth Games (CWG) 2026 in the women's 48 kg category.

questions.q: Who received the 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025), announced in July 2026?
questions.explain: Tamil poet and lyricist R. Vairamuthu received the 60th Jnanpith Award, India's highest literary honour.

questions.q: Which film won the Best Feature Film award at the 72nd National Film Awards?
questions.explain: 'Article 370' won Best Feature Film at the 72nd National Film Awards announced in July 2026.

questions.q: Van Mahotsav, the tree-planting festival observed from 1 to 7 July, was started in 1950 by ___
questions.explain: Van Mahotsav was started in 1950 by K. M. Munshi, then the Union Minister for Food and Agriculture.

questions.q: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed every year on ___
questions.explain: Kargil Vijay Diwas on 26 July marks India's victory in the 1999 Kargil War (Operation Vijay).

questions.q: The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) Raising Day is observed on 27 July. In 2026, the force celebrated its ___ Raising Day.
questions.explain: The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) celebrated its 88th Raising Day on 27 July 2026; it was formed on 27 July 1939.

questions.q: Which organisation did India hand over the chairmanship of in July 2026, after hosting its leaders' summit in New Delhi?
questions.explain: India handed over the chairmanship of BRICS (the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa grouping) after hosting its leaders' summit in New Delhi.

questions.q: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released which annual publication at the Statistics Day function on 29 June 2026?
questions.explain: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released the Statistical Year Book at Statistics Day 2026 (29 June).

questions.q: The theme of World Population Day 2026 (11 July) was ___
options: Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world
questions.explain: World Population Day is observed on 11 July; the 2026 theme centred on empowering young people to create the families they want.

questions.q: Which Indian institute developed 'Vajra', the artificial intelligence (AI)-driven unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm system inducted by the Indian Air Force in July 2026?
questions.explain: 'Vajra', an artificial intelligence (AI)-based unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm system from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi, was inducted at Hindon airbase.

questions.q: The Monsoon Session of Parliament 2026 commenced on which date?
questions.explain: The Monsoon Session of Parliament commenced on 20 July 2026.

questions.q: In July 2026, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) tightened norms on what to curb adulteration and check trans-fat content?
questions.explain: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) tightened norms for refined vegetable oils.

questions.q: India's first indigenously built research vessel, Sagar Anveshika, belongs to which institution?
options: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)
questions.explain: Sagar Anveshika is the first research vessel built fully in India, for the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai.

questions.q: Which Indian shooter won gold in the men's 25 m rapid fire pistol at the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup 2026 (Munich leg)?
questions.explain: Anish Bhanwala won the men's 25 m rapid fire pistol gold at the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup in Munich.

questions.q: Who was appointed President of the Indian National Congress in July 2026?
questions.explain: Sachin Pilot was appointed President of the Indian National Congress in July 2026, succeeding Mallikarjun Kharge.

questions.q: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) achieved a Guinness World Record in July 2026 by laying how many lane-kilometres of bituminous concrete in 24 hours?
questions.explain: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) laid 188 lane-km of bituminous concrete within 24 hours near Bengaluru — a Guinness World Record.

questions.q: The first phase of the Prime Minister's Skills and Employability Transformation through Upgraded Industrial Training Institutes (PM-SETU) scheme aims to upgrade how many government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs)?
questions.explain: Phase 1 of the Prime Minister's scheme (PM-SETU) covers 1,000 government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), of which 194 will be supported by the World Bank.

questions.q: In July 2026, which country became the first to approve a vaccine against the Nipah virus?
questions.explain: Australia became the first country to approve a vaccine against the Nipah virus (July 2026).

questions.q: The United Nations (UN) Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance was held in July 2026 at which venue?
questions.explain: The United Nations (UN) Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance was held in Geneva, Switzerland.

questions.q: Anahat Singh, who won a title at the British Junior Open 2026, is associated with which sport?
questions.explain: Anahat Singh is a squash player; she also led India at the World Squash Junior Championships 2026 in Canada.
